sloka: श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तस्याः सीता सुरसुतोपमा ।कृताञ्जलिरुवाचेदमेवमस्त्विति मैथिली ।। ६.४८.३४ ।।।।
transliteration: śrutvā tu vacanaṁ tasyāḥ sītā surasutopamā ।kṛtāñjaliruvācedamevamastviti maithilī ।। 6.48.34 ।।।।

translations.english: Sita who was like deity, on hearing the words of consolation, spoken by Trijata, greeted Trijata with palms together.
